steps.text: The last section of line is laid and you press Start at the platform. That submits one edit with no cell in it.
The server checks the line is finished. The first valid start wins and stamps its tick; later ones are rejected.
Every tab gets that one tick. The gathering call, the bell and the era change are a script played from it, so nothing else needs to travel.
A tab that sees every online player inside the ring (positions are presence) submits open.here, and the call ends early, once.
Each frame the swap reads the script at the current tick, so a late joiner lands in the same moment. The era is worked out, never stored.
